result.killer: Two findings kill it. First, under the MASAF decree of 1 Oct 2024, operators may file through their CAA (agricultural assistance centre) at no extra cost (informaimpresa summary of the decree). Second, the duty is only a quarterly, cumulative entry on the free SIAN portal: total purchases and sales for 9 cereals, split by national, EU or third-country origin. That is a few dozen numbers per quarter, not a running movements register like the wine or olive-oil ones.
result.reason: Granaio Italia is in force: sanctions apply from 31 Jul 2025 and the first entries were due 20 Oct 2025. But the decree lets operators file through their CAA at no extra cost, and farms already use CAAs for SIAN and CAP work. The filing is a quarterly set of aggregate totals for 9 cereals by origin, entered on the free SIAN portal, so a dedicated tool saves little time. The obvious buyers, co-ops and storage firms, already track tonnages in their weighbridge or warehouse systems. I found no software vendor offering the module and no documented web service, so the competitor question is open. That doesn't matter much: the free CAA route plus a light workload leave little to pay for. Thresholds and the deadline wording still differ between sources.

Since L. 8/2020 art. 7-bis the employer must tell INAIL (via CIVA, online) which body it has appointed, and the body pays INAIL 5% of its fee; plant must be declared to INAIL UOT within 30 days of activation. CPI/SCIA antincendio: periodic conformity attestation every 5 years (DPR 151/2011 art. 5). Applicability to condominiums is disputed (only if employees such as a portiere). No dedicated scheduler found for small employers or condominium administrators; generic safety suites (Blumatica SHEQ/DVR) cover training alerts, not clearly plant inspections. F-gas/heating handled by K02. Candidate A in ledger. Sources: certifico.com CIVA pages, studiocataldi.it/articoli/25085-dpr-n-4622001-applicazioni-in-ambito-condominiale.asp, puntosicuro.it faq prevenzione incendi.

Tourist flows go through regional ROSS1000-type portals (Lombardia ROSS1000, Veneto, Marche Istrice-ROSS1000, Piemonte Dati Turismo mandatory since 1 Jan 2022; monthly deadlines of about the 5th to 10th, to verify) plus Alloggiati Web within 24 h: already covered by Chekin and PMS tools (K08/K17). Organic: notification on SIAN, annual PAP (Programma Annuale di Produzione) due 31 January but postponed in 2023 (to 15 May) and 2024 (to 15 May then 1 July); handled in SIAN or regional portals (ABio Piemonte, SIB Umbria) with control-body help; no commercial PAP/organic-admin software found (international farm software irrelevant). result.competitor: SITAM itself is a free state system where armerie enter operations directly, so it covers the core filing. All4shooters (2023 and 2024) says compatible data-management software may be used if it adds no costs. I found no description of an API or import. The Consorzio Armaioli/Stain "Sigma" portal handles transport certificates for manufacturers, a different duty. I found no Italian armeria management software in 4 searches (Italian-language queries), only foreign or US armory tools and generic templates. Absence is unconfirmed because search coverage was thin.
result.duty: Art. 35 TULPS (RD 773/1931, current text per Brocardi): the armaiolo's daily operations register is electronic, shown on request and kept 50 years. SITAM (D.Lgs. 104/2018; DM of 12 Jul 2023, sources cite both no. 113 and no. 114) has been in force since 1 Sep 2023. Gun shops get credentials from the provincial Questura and enter each operation in SITAM "schede", which replaces the monthly register filing. The article says Interior systems would be finished within 18 months. Not reached: exact date use became mandatory, sanctions, and data-entry deadline.
result.market: About 1,200 retail armerie in Italy, out of 1,352 auxiliary-sector firms, per a Banco Nazionale di Prova/Università di Urbino study summary (conarmi.org PDF, undated; seen only in a search snippet, the PDF would not render). Trade bodies are Assoarmieri (Confcommercio) and Conarmi/ANPAM, which runs training such as a regulatory-update seminar on 23 Sep 2026.
result.reason: The duty is real. Art. 35 TULPS requires an electronic daily operations register kept for 50 years. SITAM has been in force since 1 Sep 2023 and replaces the monthly filing to the Questura. However, armaioli enter operations directly in SITAM's free state system using Questura credentials, so the state tool already does the core filing. A product would only add value as a shop system that syncs with SITAM. All4shooters says compatible software is allowed "without extra costs", but I found nothing on whether SITAM offers an API or file import. The market is tiny, about 1,200 armerie per an undated Urbino/Banco di Prova estimate. I found no Italian vendor, but searches were thin. I found no mandatory-use date or sanctions.

result.competitor: No Italian software vendor or module that advertises Granaio Italia filing was found in 3 Italian-language searches. Filing is done in the free SIAN portal. The Tedioli 2026 abstract mentions a role for CAAs (agricultural assistance centres) and links to operators' internal management systems, but gives no details. No source confirmed a CAA or association filing service for Granaio Italia. Not checked: whether a SIAN web service or bulk upload exists, and whether xFarm or TeamSystem Agri, or weighbridge and silo software vendors, have added it. Given the aggregated quarterly format, CAAs and existing warehouse-software vendors are the likely de facto competitors.
result.duty: Confirmed. Farms, co-ops, consortia, traders and first-processing firms that produce, hold, buy or sell cereals above per-crop annual thresholds must keep the online cereal register (Granaio Italia) in SIAN. Thresholds: 30 t durum wheat, 40 t soft wheat, 80 t maize, 40 t barley, 60 t sorghum, 30 t oats and the others. Second-stage processors and retailers are excluded. Loads and unloads are recorded as aggregated entries by the 20th of the third month after the operations, with quarterly reporting starting from Jul-Sep 2025. Fines run from EUR 500-2,000 for failing to report, up to EUR 4,000 for not following the online registration rules, and apply from 31 Jul 2025. ICQRF enforces. Sources: CNA Ravenna and Italpress (Jul 2025). The 2021 Budget Law text cited a 5 t threshold, but the implementing decree uses the per-crop thresholds. A 2026 academic paper (Tedioli, EUAL) calls the sanctions regime fully operational.
result.market: Not found. No count of registered or obliged operators was found on SIAN, MASAF or in the press. It is likely to be thousands to tens of thousands of farms above the thresholds, plus roughly hundreds to a few thousand storage firms, traders and mills, but this is an estimate, not a sourced figure.
result.reason: The duty is real and in force under Italian law: the 2021 Budget Law, MASAF DM of 1 Oct 2024, and the Milleproroghe conversion law. Fines of EUR 500-4,000 apply from 31 Jul 2025, and ICQRF does the checks. The first filing deadline was 20 Oct 2025. The thresholds in the claim match CNA Ravenna. No vendor module was found. However, entries are aggregated quarterly per crop in the free SIAN portal, so the work is small and infrequent. CAAs (Coldiretti, CIA, Confagricoltura) have a stated filing role, and larger silos and co-ops already run weighbridge or warehouse software whose vendors can add an export. The pain is low, willingness to pay is weak, and CAAs control access to farms. The best niche is small traders and mills.

The duty is real. D.Lgs. 101/2020 art. 48 requires STRIMS registration, and ISIN and FNOVI sources say it covers vet studios with fixed or mobile X-ray units. But it looks mostly one-off. The registration deadline was around Jan 2022, and the later human-health extension to 31 Mar 2023 does not cover vets. I found no recurring workflow after registration, only event-driven communications within 10 days of a change. A 2024 Mantova vet order note suggests staff are usually classed as non-exposed, so the radiation-protection expert (ERP) burden may be light. I found no vet-specific software, but only two searches covered it and I did not check packaged ERP services or vet practice suites. Market size was not found. The Mantova 2024 PDF was unreadable. Weak recurrence and small willingness to pay give a low score.

Duty is real: TULPS art.128 (kept in force per Interior Ministry and MISE res. 120995/2018) requires a daily register of operations with counterparty identity, shown to police on request. Beni culturali art.63 adds item descriptions. Non-vidimation is only an administrative offence (Cass. 12646/2006). I found no dedicated Italian software. Foreign consignment POS (The Consignment Shop) and generic retail POS (Passepartout Retail) exist, but none was shown to generate this register. I could not confirm that an electronic register is allowed. I found no national count (ATECO 47.79 stock not found) and no enforcement data beyond a 2019 carabinieri-check news item. Score is low because demand is weak: the register is a low-value paper habit, enforcement is sporadic, and buyers are tiny and fragmented. Related to K18.

Duty is real. MIT circolare 9674 of 16 Apr 2026 applies G2V2 and driver cards from 1 Jul 2026 to 2.5-3.5 t vehicles in international for-hire or cabotage haulage, and to international own-account haulage where driving is the main activity. Trans.info gives fines of EUR 866-3,464, a 10-day installation order and licence suspension. Company card, driver-card download every 28 days and memory download every 90 days are required. Competition is strong: Geotab and Frotcom already sell remote download and expiry alerts. Market size is unquantified. No Italian count was found, only "thousands" of firms. The IRU survey, as cited by trans.info, put 88% of affected vehicles as not yet equipped (before the deadline). The work is a one-off install plus routine downloads, and derogations shrink the pool. A thin niche for a solo founder.

The duty is real. DM 2/2026 (of 13 Jan 2026, GU n.66 of 20 Mar 2026, in force 9 Apr 2026) extends the annual associative-data communication to all associative ETS, with a 30 June deadline. Bilancio deposit moves to 180 days after year end. Sanctions fall under CTS art. 48 c.5, but I found no amounts. The RUNTS had 150,194 entities at 20 Jul 2026, but the associative-ETS count is not found. Competitors: TeamSystem Terzo Settore in Cloud, Asso360, bespoke gestionali from EUR 1,200, and free CSV volunteer-centre help. I did not find any API that pushes data to RUNTS; filing is manual, but the data is a few counts. The pain is low and the buyers are volunteer bodies with little willingness to pay. Accountants are the real buyer, and the filing is a once-a-year, thin job. Ranghi, Zucchetti and Cantiere Terzo Settore were not checked, and "Modello E" was not found in the sources.

The duty is real: the MIMIT portal and the DM 31 Mar 2023 require price notification on each change and at least weekly (per Sicurauto), plus an average-price sign. The GdF is enforcing it, with fines in Como and Ferrara. Sanctions of EUR 200-2,000 per day come from a secondary source only. DL 33/2026 (converted by L. 79/2026) mainly binds oil companies (0.1% of daily turnover), not gestori. I found no dedicated third-party software, but I also found no API or bulk-upload spec. The free MIMIT portal does the core job, and the DM allows free intermediated or simplified transmission by agreement. Brand networks and POS vendors probably push prices already. The task is a few minutes per change, the buyers are fragmented (about 20k stations, not sourced here), and willingness to pay is low. The niche is thin.

Duty is real: D.Lgs. 43/2025 and ADM circ. 9/D (7 May 2026), then circ. 20/2026 (31 Jul 2026). PV above 20 kW with self-consumption needs an officina elettrica licence, an annual fee (1-16 Dec), monthly meter readings, and semi-annual filings (30 Sep, 31 Mar). No extension of 30 Sep 2026 found. The first deadline has now passed. Penalties were not found. QualEnergia questions whether renewables are covered. No dedicated software found, only the ADM portal, associations and consultants. Plant count unverified, so the market is probably small, a few tens of thousands at most. The work is only two filings a year plus a register, so the pain is low and the job is easily handled by accountants or installers. Low willingness to pay.

Duty is real: DPR 462/2001 art. 4 requires earthing and lightning checks every 5 years, or every 2 years for construction sites, medical rooms and CPI or fire-risk premises. The employer pays. The CPI renewal is a 5-year declaration under DPR 151/2011. Not confirmed: the penalty (I believe D.Lgs 81/2008 art. 87), CIVA/INAIL art. 7-bis details and market counts. Competition is not empty. RegistroSicuro.it covers extinguishers and emergency lighting. Blumatica, TeamSystem HR and Namirial give training-expiry alerts. Nothing found bundles earthing, CPI and the INAIL notification, but the cycles are slow (5 years) and a consultant/RSPP does this cheaply. Looks like generic compliance software. Fragmented buyers, weak willingness to pay.

The duty looks real. Reg. IVASS 40/2018 requires periodic training, and agents, brokers and section D intermediaries must train their section E network. I did not confirm the hours: one provider page says 30 h/yr, and the official text was not reached. Provv. 134/2023 only covers SPID/CIE/CNS portal access and electronic communications, not training. I found no dedicated training-tracking software, but my agency-suite search was shallow. Training providers and agency suites probably track hours already. No section counts were found. The product is a niche tracker with little distinct pain and unclear willingness to pay, and agencies' existing providers and ANIA/SNA suites are likely substitutes.

The core recurring duty no longer exists as claimed. Regione Lombardia (page updated 19 Mar 2026) says MASAF decree n. 0149834 of 1 Apr 2025 repealed DM 18321/2012, the legal basis of the annual PAP with its 31 January deadline. PAP content now goes into the piano colturale grafico, which sits in the fascicolo aziendale. That is already done through CAAs, regions and the SIAN/AGRIBIO portals. No 2026 PAP deadline was found. The first notification is a one-off, filed on free state or regional portals (e.g. AGRIBIO in Emilia-Romagna). Market: about 94,441 organic operators in 2023, about 84,000 of them farms. Competition (xFarm and others) was not verified. Only the one-off notification and certificate follow-up remain, so the recurring pain is weak.
